candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record identifies a confluent retroperitoneal soft-tissue mass encasing vessels with medial deviation of ureters — classic imaging features of retroperitoneal fibrosis. Bilateral ureteral obstruction is the complication/manifestation that caused the acute kidney injury, but the requested final diagnostic object is the underlying etiology (idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis). C001 names only the downstream anatomical effect, not the primary disease entity.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Bilateral ureteral obstruction is the anatomical consequence/manifestation of retroperitoneal fibrosis, not the underlying diagnosis itself

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis; no biopsy or IgG4 serology documented, but imaging description (confluent retroperitoneal mass, medial ureteral deviation) is classic and supports the diagnosis clinically
